name: Cerveruela (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a yellow leaping stag, with quarter-circles of the bars of Aragon in the corners and half-circles at the top and bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Cerveruela; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: quarter-circles and half-circles of yellow and red bars at the edges
